title: Honor the one through whom you arrived
summary: The one through whom life arrives cannot be spoken of with contempt. Do not diminish the one the Guru honors.
takeaway: Do not diminish the one the Guru honors.
lifeApplication: Before contempt reaches the mouth, remember whom the Guru has already honored and choose the cleaner word.

source.shortMeaning: The one through whom life arrives cannot be spoken of with contempt.
source.lifeApplication: Before speaking of women lightly, remember that every lineage passes through them.

evidence.coreClaim: The one through whom life arrives cannot be spoken of with contempt.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: refuse to despise the one through whom human life comes.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before contempt reaches the mouth, remember whom the Guru has already honored and choose the cleaner word.
